chx_cpa.description: Droplet screen with 10 mM substrate, 20 mM amine, 5 mM NADPH, 100 mM Tris/HCl pH 8.0; source aggregate combines 3 and 22 h conditions. Incubation temperature is unspecified in the cited droplet-method paragraph. Fitness is natural-log enrichment relative to wild type.
chx_cpa.method_source: doi:10.1101/2024.04.08.588565v2, Methods: Ultra-high throughput screening in droplets

chx_menh2.description: Droplet screen with 10 mM substrate, 20 mM amine, 5 mM NADPH, 100 mM Tris/HCl pH 8.0; source aggregate combines 22 and 92 h conditions. Incubation temperature is unspecified in the cited droplet-method paragraph. Fitness is natural-log enrichment relative to wild type.
chx_menh2.method_source: doi:10.1101/2024.04.08.588565v2, Methods: Ultra-high throughput screening in droplets

mepy.description: Droplet screen with 10 mM substrate, 5 mM NADPH, 100 mM Tris/HCl pH 8.0; source aggregate combines 3 and 24 h conditions. Incubation temperature is unspecified in the cited droplet-method paragraph. Fitness is natural-log enrichment relative to wild type.
mepy.method_source: doi:10.1101/2024.04.08.588565v2, Methods: Ultra-high throughput screening in droplets

endpoint.description: Published droplet-screen log-enrichment responses for a sequence-selected SrIRED panel across three substrate contexts. Each context retains its screen-specific incubation and wild-type normalization.
